preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT count(*) FROM pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'uk_eqa_result_dist_org_test'

changeSet.comment: A result tied to a panel sample is unique per sample; one with no sample (a V1 row, or a scheme whose panel sealed nothing for that test) stays unique per test. One constraint over a nullable column cannot say both, because Postgres treats every NULL as distinct.
